item.title: Episode 2: The Week of November 16, 2026
item.description: Both Boerne football teams won in Laredo on Thursday night, Champion beating McAllen 72 to 14 and the Greyhounds beating Mercedes 41 to 7, and both advance to the regional semifinals. Boerne ISD trustees reviewed a boundary committee recommendation that would move the Esperanza neighborhood to Voss Middle School and put the full Fabra Elementary zone in the Boerne Middle School North zone, with a decision set for December 14. Teachers across the district received more than $200,000 in Teacher Innovation Grants from the Boerne Education Foundation. The November 3 election results are official after Commissioners Court canvassed the returns, 26,311 ballots at 65.11 percent turnout, and the hand-count audit matched the electronic results. A Kendall County jury gave Allen Graham Jr. the maximum sentence, 20 years for intoxication manslaughter, in the fatal Interstate 10 crash near Comfort that killed Manuela Rodriguez. The development watch covers a setback request at 714 High Street in Comfort and two releases of subdivision financial guarantees. The City of Boerne met with residents on Phase 2 of the Adler Road reconstruction. Two Boerne authors won first place in the Texas State Genealogical Society's 2026 Book Awards for Murder in Boerne, Texas, their account of an 1868 Kendall County murder case. And Operation Christmas Child collection week runs through Monday, November 23, at St. John Lutheran Church. This episode was built only from stories The Kendall Wire reported and published the week of November 16, 2026. The voices are AI-generated.

item.title: Episode 1: The Week of November 9, 2026
item.description: The Greyhounds roll in their playoff opener, both Boerne girls teams open basketball season with wins, and three volleyball seasons come to an end. The GVTC Foundation awards $662,754 in grants to 183 nonprofits. Kendall County marks Veterans Day with the Purple Heart Project gala and the ceremony at Veterans Plaza, and the plaza's bronze turns 34. New World screwworm is found in Bandera County. TxDOT updates residents on the Texas 46 West safety project. And the holiday calendar fills up with Dickens on Main and the 40th Christmas in Comfort. This episode was built only from stories The Kendall Wire reported and published the week of November 9, 2026. The voices are AI-generated.
